Five (5) years’ experience as a licensed respiratory care practitioner, with a minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the work areas associated with certifications held

The Respiratory Therapist II – Lead assists the Supervisor with overseeing the daily operations and making day-to-day operational decisions for the department respiratory therapists, maintaining equipment, ensuring quality, and cost management. The incumbent is responsible for evaluating pulmonary dysfunction and performing cardiopulmonary procedures to treat and care for the patient employing respiratory therapy and ventilatory assistance. Additionally, provides day-to-day operational direction, within their realm, to the team and offers essential support, resources and guidance to each co-worker, enabling them to perform their duties well.
Must be a graduate of an AMA-approved Respiratory Care Program.
Hold current Adult Critical Care Specialist (ACCS), Neonatal/Pediatric Specialist (NPS), and/or Asthma Educator Specialist
Must be a Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) by the National Board for Respiratory Care.
(AE-C) credentials from the National Board for Respiratory Care (NBRC) or are in the process of obtaining them.
Current Pediatric Advanced Life Support (Required). • Current coworkers will be grandfathered until December 31st, 2027, at which time, will be required to have PALS credentials.
Current Neonatal Resuscitation Protocol (Required at Academic Medical Center Locations and Fountain Valley)
